categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor sanity checking in `src/script/descriptor.cpp`, which governs descriptor validation and key management for descriptor wallets.
categories.rationale: Prevents Tapscript Miniscript descriptors with duplicate x-only keys from passing sanity checks, avoiding third-party transaction malleability. Without this check, 'because Tapscript drops key parity on-chain, both branches serialize to identical scripts, violating BIP-379 invariants against duplicate keys and allowing third parties to malleate transactions by switching execution branches without possessing private keys' (#36414, PR description).
